proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d e f ha
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, q, h⟩
    have h0 := h 0
    have h1 := h 1
    have h2 := h (-1)
    linear_combination (1 / 2) * h1 + (1 / 2) * h2 - h0
  · intro hd
    subst hd
    have hp : 2 * d * ((b - e) / (2 * d)) = b - e := by field_simp
    generalize (b - e) / (2 * d) = p at hp
    refine ⟨p, f - d * p ^ 2 + b * p - c, fun x => ?_⟩
    linear_combination x * hp
target_source: ∀ (a b c d e f : ℝ), a ≠ 0 → ((∃ p q : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, d * x ^ 2 + e * x + f = a * (x - p) ^ 2 + b * (x - p) + c + q) ↔ d = a)
